meta.title: Descent
meta.description: When you become a performer in the play, you will long for someone to come save you.

units.rawText: In this virtual world, where even the laws of physics are created from data, once the figures are right, they can perfectly display scenes which would be hard to imagine in the real world.
units.displayText: In this virtual world, where even the laws of physics are created from data, once the figures are right, they can perfectly display scenes which would be hard to imagine in the real world.

spans.text: In this virtual world, where even the laws of physics are created from data, once the figures are right, they can perfectly display scenes which would be hard to imagine in the real world.

units.rawText: An agent, a sniper rifle, an endless series of gunshots, and bullets pouring down like rain.
units.displayText: An agent, a sniper rifle, an endless series of gunshots, and bullets pouring down like rain.

spans.text: An agent, a sniper rifle, an endless series of gunshots, and bullets pouring down like rain.

units.rawText: All we can do is huddle behind the statues in the garden, catching our breath as this absolute suppressive fire pins us down.
units.displayText: All we can do is huddle behind the statues in the garden, catching our breath as this absolute suppressive fire pins us down.

spans.text: All we can do is huddle behind the statues in the garden, catching our breath as this absolute suppressive fire pins us down.

units.rawText: Is she firing a sniper rifle or a Gatling gun? This is the sort of firepower you'd expect from an entire infantry platoon, right!?
units.displayText: Is she firing a sniper rifle or a Gatling gun? This is the sort of firepower you'd expect from an entire infantry platoon, right!?

spans.text: Is she firing a sniper rifle or a Gatling gun? This is the sort of firepower you'd expect from an entire infantry platoon, right!?

units.rawText: At this rate, she's going to shoot our cover to bits!
units.displayText: At this rate, she's going to shoot our cover to bits!

spans.text: At this rate, she's going to shoot our cover to bits!

units.rawText: Whoosh— Bang—
units.displayText: Whoosh— Bang—

spans.text: Whoosh— Bang—

units.rawText: Right on cue, a bullet grazes past a part of the statue above my head, throwing up a spray of tiny data fragments that scratch up my face.
units.displayText: Right on cue, a bullet grazes past a part of the statue above my head, throwing up a spray of tiny data fragments that scratch up my face.

spans.text: Right on cue, a bullet grazes past a part of the statue above my head, throwing up a spray of tiny data fragments that scratch up my face.

units.rawText: You can't apply common sense to the Entropics, and Intermediate Sanctifiers are pretty tough customers to begin with!
units.displayText: You can't apply common sense to the Entropics, and Intermediate Sanctifiers are pretty tough customers to begin with!

spans.text: You can't apply common sense to the Entropics, and Intermediate Sanctifiers are pretty tough customers to begin with!

units.rawText: Professor, what should we do!?
units.displayText: Professor, what should we do!?

spans.text: Professor, what should we do!?
Fall back.
Change tactics.

units.rawText: Let's fall back. The problem in the Pierides Sector isn't something we can deal with anymore.
units.displayText: Let's fall back. The problem in the Pierides Sector isn't something we can deal with anymore.

spans.text: Let's fall back. The problem in the Pierides Sector isn't something we can deal with anymore.

units.rawText: Are you abandoning the operation?
units.displayText: Are you abandoning the operation?

spans.text: Are you abandoning the operation?

units.rawText: Fighting for an impossible cause isn't always courage. Sometimes it's just stupidity.
units.displayText: Fighting for an impossible cause isn't always courage. Sometimes it's just stupidity.

spans.text: Fighting for an impossible cause isn't always courage. Sometimes it's just stupidity.

units.rawText: You draw her attention, I'll try to use my administrator permissions to...
units.displayText: You draw her attention, I'll try to use my administrator permissions to...

spans.text: You draw her attention, I'll try to use my administrator permissions to...

units.rawText: The sound of gunfire stops for a moment and a red line extends past my side.
units.displayText: The sound of gunfire stops for a moment and a red line extends past my side.

spans.text: The sound of gunfire stops for a moment and a red line extends past my side.

units.rawText: Scatter!
units.displayText: Scatter!

spans.text: Scatter!

units.rawText: BOOM—
units.displayText: BOOM—

spans.text: BOOM—

units.rawText: A massive explosion sends us flying, and we each have to scramble for new cover.
units.displayText: A massive explosion sends us flying, and we each have to scramble for new cover.

spans.text: A massive explosion sends us flying, and we each have to scramble for new cover.

units.rawText: This impact... I'm having trouble telling if they're bullets or hand grenades!
units.displayText: This impact... I'm having trouble telling if they're bullets or hand grenades!

spans.text: This impact... I'm having trouble telling if they're bullets or hand grenades!

units.rawText: I'll draw her fire, you guys take the opportunity to leave!
units.displayText: I'll draw her fire, you guys take the opportunity to leave!

spans.text: I'll draw her fire, you guys take the opportunity to leave!

units.rawText: Don't be reckless! Wisdom is a sniper—the moment you're exposed, she'll hit you, 100%! Don't tempt fate!
units.displayText: Don't be reckless! Wisdom is a sniper—the moment you're exposed, she'll hit you, 100%! Don't tempt fate!

spans.text: Don't be reckless! Wisdom is a sniper—the moment you're exposed, she'll hit you, 100%! Don't tempt fate!

units.rawText: Antonina, disrupt her remotely with your Trojans and cover our retreat!
units.displayText: Antonina, disrupt her remotely with your Trojans and cover our retreat!

spans.text: Antonina, disrupt her remotely with your Trojans and cover our retreat!

units.rawText: No can do! Wisdom is essentially a walking mass of errors and bugs right now, the Trojans won't do any good!
units.displayText: No can do! Wisdom is essentially a walking mass of errors and bugs right now, the Trojans won't do any good!

spans.text: No can do! Wisdom is essentially a walking mass of errors and bugs right now, the Trojans won't do any good!

units.rawText: Dammit, at this rate we won't even have the chance to put up a fight!
units.displayText: Dammit, at this rate we won't even have the chance to put up a fight!

spans.text: Dammit, at this rate we won't even have the chance to put up a fight!

units.rawText: Ignoring the others' muttered curses and the bullets whizzing past...
units.displayText: Ignoring the others' muttered curses and the bullets whizzing past...

spans.text: Ignoring the others' muttered curses and the bullets whizzing past...

units.rawText: I focus as I have never focused before as countless plans speed through my mind.
units.displayText: I focus as I have never focused before as countless plans speed through my mind.

spans.text: I focus as I have never focused before as countless plans speed through my mind.

units.rawText: Whoosh— Bang—
units.displayText: Whoosh— Bang—

spans.text: Whoosh— Bang—

units.rawText: Just then, Wisdom turns her attention to Antonina, and her charged shot hits the statue she's hiding behind.
units.displayText: Just then, Wisdom turns her attention to Antonina, and her charged shot hits the statue she's hiding behind.

spans.text: Just then, Wisdom turns her attention to Antonina, and her charged shot hits the statue she's hiding behind.

units.rawText: The statue promptly disintegrates, and a shower of fallen rocks pins her in place.
units.displayText: The statue promptly disintegrates, and a shower of fallen rocks pins her in place.

spans.text: The statue promptly disintegrates, and a shower of fallen rocks pins her in place.

units.rawText: (Coughs heavily)
units.displayText: Coughs heavily

spans.text: Coughs heavily

units.rawText: Anna!
units.displayText: Anna!

spans.text: Anna!

units.rawText: The red line extends again, landing on Antonina, who is now exposed to Wisdom.
units.displayText: The red line extends again, landing on Antonina, who is now exposed to Wisdom.

spans.text: The red line extends again, landing on Antonina, who is now exposed to Wisdom.

units.rawText: Fight back! Don't give Wisdom a chance to fire on Antonina!
units.displayText: Fight back! Don't give Wisdom a chance to fire on Antonina!

spans.text: Fight back! Don't give Wisdom a chance to fire on Antonina!

units.rawText: Sol leaps out in response while Persicaria dashes towards Antonina, trying to free her.
units.displayText: Sol leaps out in response while Persicaria dashes towards Antonina, trying to free her.

spans.text: Sol leaps out in response while Persicaria dashes towards Antonina, trying to free her.

units.rawText: Meanwhile, I pick up a weapon part severed from a Sanctifier and start putting pressure on Wisdom.
units.displayText: Meanwhile, I pick up a weapon part severed from a Sanctifier and start putting pressure on Wisdom.

spans.text: Meanwhile, I pick up a weapon part severed from a Sanctifier and start putting pressure on Wisdom.

units.rawText: We succeed in drawing Wisdom's attention.
units.displayText: We succeed in drawing Wisdom's attention.

spans.text: We succeed in drawing Wisdom's attention.

units.rawText: And then—
units.displayText: And then—

spans.text: And then—

units.rawText: Bang—
units.displayText: Bang—

spans.text: Bang—

units.rawText: The next second, a mighty force hits me in my right shoulder and sends me flying a good distance.
units.displayText: The next second, a mighty force hits me in my right shoulder and sends me flying a good distance.

spans.text: The next second, a mighty force hits me in my right shoulder and sends me flying a good distance.

units.rawText: Ugh—
units.displayText: Ugh—

spans.text: Ugh—

units.rawText: I roll across the ground, and the impact of my landing even manages to drown out the pain of the gunshot for a moment.
units.displayText: I roll across the ground, and the impact of my landing even manages to drown out the pain of the gunshot for a moment.

spans.text: I roll across the ground, and the impact of my landing even manages to drown out the pain of the gunshot for a moment.

units.rawText: Professor!
units.displayText: Professor!

spans.text: Professor!

units.rawText: <size=44>GODDAMMIT, STOP IT YOU BITCH!</size>
units.displayText: GODDAMMIT, STOP IT YOU BITCH!

spans.text: GODDAMMIT, STOP IT YOU BITCH!

units.rawText: Bang— Bang—
units.displayText: Bang— Bang—

spans.text: Bang— Bang—

units.rawText: With just two shots, Wisdom neutralizes our resistance. Sol and Persicaria collapse to the ground before they can even make a sound.
units.displayText: With just two shots, Wisdom neutralizes our resistance. Sol and Persicaria collapse to the ground before they can even make a sound.

spans.text: With just two shots, Wisdom neutralizes our resistance. Sol and Persicaria collapse to the ground before they can even make a sound.

units.rawText: The sound of gunfire ceases. Wisdom puts her gun away and heads toward us.
units.displayText: The sound of gunfire ceases. Wisdom puts her gun away and heads toward us.

spans.text: The sound of gunfire ceases. Wisdom puts her gun away and heads toward us.

units.rawText: Her joints no longer seem to work, and she shuffles along.
units.displayText: Her joints no longer seem to work, and she shuffles along.

spans.text: Her joints no longer seem to work, and she shuffles along.

units.rawText: The sound of her sticky, dragging footsteps slowly draws closer.
units.displayText: The sound of her sticky, dragging footsteps slowly draws closer.

spans.text: The sound of her sticky, dragging footsteps slowly draws closer.

units.rawText: (I need to move.)
units.displayText: I need to move.

spans.text: I need to move.

units.rawText: She raises her gun, the gunsights converging on my forehead.
units.displayText: She raises her gun, the gunsights converging on my forehead.

spans.text: She raises her gun, the gunsights converging on my forehead.

units.rawText: I try to raise my arm, but after struggling for a bit, I realize that I can't change anything with just my still-intact left arm.
units.displayText: I try to raise my arm, but after struggling for a bit, I realize that I can't change anything with just my still-intact left arm.

spans.text: I try to raise my arm, but after struggling for a bit, I realize that I can't change anything with just my still-intact left arm.

units.rawText: <color=purple>Argh—gah—</color>
units.displayText: Argh—gah—

spans.text: Argh—gah—

units.rawText: I close my eyes and await the gunshot powerlessly.
units.displayText: I close my eyes and await the gunshot powerlessly.

spans.text: I close my eyes and await the gunshot powerlessly.

units.rawText: Bang—
units.displayText: Bang—

spans.text: Bang—
